_note: Draft opening orders for Mon 5 Oct 2026 at the US open. Amounts in USD; shares and price are computed from the real price fetched at execution. Review reasons before running.

orders.reason: AI capex is still what's leading this market: the Nasdaq closed near a record on 2 Oct even with the 10-year above 5%. Catalyst: Q3 earnings and AI spend. Risk: high yields and crowded leadership. Exit: sell 12% below entry, or trim above 30% weight.

Brent near $100 supports producer cash flows and tilts us toward the energy shock. Catalyst: Gulf escalation (third US carrier) and China's fuel-export halt. Risk: de-escalation or SPR releases. Exit: Brent closes below $90 for 3 sessions, or 10% below entry.

Higher policy rates support bank net interest income. Catalyst: JPM/C/GS/WFC report 13 Oct and BAC 14 Oct. Risk: credit stress from 5%+ long yields and a softer labour market. Exit: review after bank earnings; sell 10% below entry.

Breadth looks washed out: RSP lagged SPY by 4.6 pp in September and only 12% of sub-industries are above their 50/200-day averages. Catalyst: soft jobs data cut October hike odds to ~22%. Risk: a hike on 28 Oct or new highs in yields. Exit: 8% below entry, or Fed hike plus a new high in the 10-year.

0-3 month T-bills earn roughly the policy rate (fed funds 3.75-4.00%) with minimal price risk. Dry powder for after CPI 14 Oct, FOMC 28 Oct and midterms 3 Nov. Risk: lags if equities rip. Exit: rotate into equities on a pullback or confirmed thesis.
